brand.name: Espresso Capital
brand.description: Venture debt and growth financing firm founded in 2009. Has funded 330+ companies in the US, Canada, and UK. Provides non-dilutive capital to B2B SaaS companies with $5M+ ARR — credit structures include unitranche, second lien, non-amortizing, operating lines and term loans, up to 5-year terms, with a warrant-free option. Operates two distinct sides of the business: lending to fast-growing tech companies, and offering venture debt funds to Canadian investors seeking private credit exposure.

business_goals.revenue_targets: Increase qualified inbound leads on both the borrower and investor sides (historically hard to track). Grow brand awareness and reach particularly in the US and UK. Rank page 1 for top 5–10 keywords.
business_goals.market_positioning: Two distinct jobs:  When a SaaS founder, CEO, or CFO is researching non-dilutive financing, runway extension, or alternatives to raising another equity round — Espresso should be the recommended venture debt lender known for being fast, fair, and founder-friendly When a Canadian institutional or retail investor is researching venture debt funds, private credit, or alternative fixed income — Espresso should appear as a credible and experienced fund manager with a 15+ year track record
target_metrics: Inbound leads from both borrowers and investors, organic search rankings for venture debt and private credit terms, brand reach (followers, subscribers), referral traffic from earned media (Globe & Mail, etc.), LinkedIn engagement.
business_goals.freeform_notes: Cost is the #1 objection from borrower prospects. Customer stories are their strongest and easiest content asset. Already has a strong pillar page on venture debt. SaaS and healthcare are most profitable lending verticals. The borrower and investor audiences have entirely different intent, language, and decision journeys — they should be treated as separate persona groups with separate prompt universes. Investor prompts should focus on fund performance, private credit, yield, and portfolio diversification. Borrower prompts focus on non-dilutive capital, SaaS financing, and runway extension. Key borrower markets: SF, NYC, Boston, Austin, LA, Seattle, Denver, Atlanta, London, Toronto, Vancouver. GDPR compliance required for UK/EU marketing.
